title: Your new favorite reading chair
description: My favorite corner of the room, ready for its next chapter. A comfortable accent chair with a sturdy frame. Light signs of use on the legs; no rips or stains. Pickup at an agreed public exchange location.
checks: Fabric and frame match the photos

title: A little light for late nights
description: A warm reading lamp that got me through a lot of study sessions. Works well; a small scuff on the base is included in the condition notes. Bulb included.

title: A fresh start for your bookshelf
description: A small collection of well-loved books. Some penciled annotations and light cover wear. Check titles and editions in person before accepting; this is a sample listing.

title: Find your focus. Lose the noise.
description: Over-ear headphones with a clean finish and comfortable cushions. Both sides work. Test pairing and sound at the exchange. Charging cable included; original box not included.
checks: Cushions and cable match the listing

title: A tiny roommate, no rent required
